tools.name: roo-code-index-search
tools.description: Search a workspace code index. Prefers a standalone index owned by this MCP (rci-*); otherwise falls back to the read-only legacy Roo Code index. The response reports which index family served the results.

workspace_path.description: Absolute path to the workspace whose code index should be searched. Omit to search all bridge indexes (federated).

directory_prefix.description: Optional workspace-relative subdirectory filter. Leave blank for the full workspace.

limit.description: Optional result limit override. Use 0 to keep the configured default.

min_score.description: Optional similarity threshold override. Use a negative value to keep the configured default.

tools.name: roo-code-index-resolve-collection
tools.description: Resolve the Roo Code Qdrant collection name for a workspace path and show the candidate hashes that were checked.

workspace_path.description: Absolute path to the workspace whose Roo Code collection should be resolved.

tools.name: roo-code-index-health
tools.description: Report configuration, Qdrant connectivity, embedder connectivity, SQLite state, parser availability, and optional workspace resolution.

workspace_path.description: Optional absolute workspace path for index resolution status.

tools.name: code-index-build
tools.description: Build or safely rebuild the standalone semantic index for a workspace. Returns structured progress evidence; a failed rebuild never touches the last good index.

workspace_path.description: Absolute path of the workspace to index.

force.description: Force a full rebuild through a staging collection and atomic alias swap.

watch.description: Start the file watcher after a successful build.

tools.name: code-index-sync
tools.description: Incrementally index changed, added, and deleted files. Unchanged files are not re-embedded.

workspace_path.description: Absolute path of the workspace to synchronize.

tools.name: code-index-search
tools.description: Search a workspace's standalone index (paths, line ranges, symbols, scores). Omit workspace_path to search across all bridge-managed indexes at once.

workspace_path.description: Absolute path of the indexed workspace. Omit to search ALL indexes (federated).

limit.description: Optional result limit override. Use 0 for the configured default.

min_score.description: Optional score threshold override. Use a negative value for the configured default.

path_glob.description: Optional glob filter on workspace-relative paths, e.g. 'src/*.py'.

tools.name: code-index-status
tools.description: Report collection, embedder fingerprint, file/chunk counts, watcher state, last sync, active job, and last error for a workspace.

workspace_path.description: Absolute path of the indexed workspace.

tools.name: code-index-list
tools.description: List standalone indexes owned by this MCP (rci-* collections only; legacy ws-*/ca_* collections are never listed or touched).

tools.name: code-index-delete
tools.description: Delete the standalone index for a workspace after ownership verification. Requires confirmation to equal the normalized workspace path. Never touches ca_* or ws-* collections.

workspace_path.description: Absolute path of the workspace whose index should be deleted.

confirmation.description: Must exactly equal the normalized workspace path; deletion is refused otherwise.

tools.name: code-index-health
tools.description: Report Qdrant, embedder, SQLite, parser availability, active jobs, and watcher health without exposing secrets.

tools.name: code-index-watch-start
tools.description: Start an explicit watcher for a workspace. Debounced change bursts are coalesced into one incremental sync; duplicate starts are idempotent. Watchers live only while this server runs.

workspace_path.description: Absolute path of the workspace to watch.

tools.name: code-index-watch-stop
tools.description: Stop the watcher for a workspace and report its final state.

workspace_path.description: Absolute path of the watched workspace.
